headlines.title: 中证报头版文章：统筹平衡多重目标，精准施策用好货币政策工具，降准、降息仍在政策工具箱内
headlines.summary: 日前召开的中共中央政治局会议对货币政策作出新的部署，人民银行2026年下半年工作会议进一步细化落实要求，释放清晰政策信号。专家表示，在推动经济持续向新向优向好发展过程中，货币政策需要统筹平衡多重目标。当前，降准、降息仍在政策工具箱内，操作上将更加注重相机抉择，并把握好实施时点与力度；结构性工具将持续加码，聚焦科技创新、新质生产力、中小微企业等重点领域补短板。与此同时，财政金融协同促内需政策将持续优化，为经济持续回升向好营造适宜货币金融环境。

headlines.title_en: China Securities Journal front-page article: Balancing multiple objectives with precision, using monetary policy tools appropriately; RRR cuts and rate cuts remain in the policy toolbox.
headlines.summary_en: The recent Political Bureau meeting of the CPC Central Committee made new arrangements for monetary policy, and the PBOC's H2 2026 work conference further detailed implementation requirements, sending a clear policy signal. Experts say that in promoting sustained economic improvement, monetary policy needs to balance multiple objectives. Currently, RRR cuts and rate cuts remain in the policy toolkit, with operations focusing more on discretionary timing and力度. Structural tools will continue to be strengthened, targeting sci-tech innovation, new quality productive forces, and SMEs to shore up weaknesses. Meanwhile, fiscal-financial coordination to boost domestic demand will continue to be optimized, creating a suitable monetary and financial environment for the economy's sustained recovery.

headlines.title: 房贷利率下探至2.8%以下，银行设置客户资质与合作渠道门槛
headlines.summary: 记者8月6日以购房者身份走访或致电北京、广州、杭州等地多家银行，发现多数银行房贷利率仍不低于3%。部分外资银行能够提供利率低于2.8%的住房贷款，不过这类低息贷款设置了客户资质与合作渠道等门槛。有银行表示，虽然无法下调贷款利率，但可通过合作楼盘给予购房者一定的房价优惠。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Mortgage rates drop below 2.8%, with banks setting client qualification and channel partnership thresholds.
headlines.summary_en: On August 6, a reporter visited or called banks in Beijing, Guangzhou, Hangzhou and elsewhere as a homebuyer, finding that most banks' mortgage rates remain no lower than 3%. Some foreign banks can offer housing loans below 2.8%, though such low-rate loans have thresholds on client qualifications and cooperation channels. Some banks said that while they cannot cut loan rates, they can offer homebuyers certain price discounts through partnered developments. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 企业融资迎来新选项，十余省份落地DR基准利率贷款
headlines.summary: 近期，以DR（存款类金融机构债券回购利率）为基准利率的贷款“多点开花”，打破了贷款定价单一锚定LPR（贷款市场报价利率）的旧模式。据统计，约15个省份已有这类贷款落地，国有大行、股份行、地方法人银行均已布局，央企、国企、民企、外资企业等多类经营主体已“尝鲜”。DR作为贷款利率新“锚点”投入应用，不仅奏响了利率市场化改革新章，也为企业融资提供了全新的定价选项。业内人士认为，DR基准利率贷款将为企业融资带来多重利好。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: New financing options for enterprises: DR-based benchmark rate loans launched in over a dozen provinces.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, loans benchmarked to DR (deposit-taking financial institutions' bond repurchase rate) have been 'blossoming everywhere', breaking the old model of loan pricing being solely anchored to LPR (Loan Prime Rate). According to statistics, such loans have been rolled out in about 15 provinces, with state-owned large banks, joint-stock banks, and local legal-person banks all deploying them, and central SOEs, local SOEs, private firms, and foreign enterprises among the first to use them. DR's application as a new 'anchor' for loan rates not only marks a new chapter in interest rate marketization reform but also provides enterprises with a brand-new pricing option. Industry insiders believe that DR-benchmarked loans will bring multiple benefits to corporate financing. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 一线城市土地市场持续火热
headlines.summary: 一段时间以来，国内一线城市土地市场热度不减。北京、上海、广州、深圳等一线城市的优质住宅用地接连出让，多宗地块经过数十轮乃至数百轮竞价成交，溢价率保持高位。在房地产市场延续止跌回稳态势、“好房子”建设持续推进的背景下，不少城市的核心地段楼面价也有所走高，显示出房企投资重心进一步向优质土地资源集中的态势。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: First-tier city land markets remain notably active.
headlines.summary_en: For some time, land market momentum in first-tier cities has remained strong. Prime residential land in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen and other first-tier cities has been successively sold, with many plots transacting after dozens or even hundreds of bidding rounds and premium rates staying high. Amid the property market's continued stabilization and the push for 'good housing' construction, floor prices in core urban areas of many cities have also risen, showing developers' investment focus further concentrating on prime land resources. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title: 促投资稳工业扩外贸，地方经济“下半场”划重点
headlines.summary: 近期，各地密集部署下半年经济工作，聚焦推进“六张网”规划建设、实现工业经济稳定增长、全力稳住外贸基本盘等领域，相关举措也将陆续落地。梳理发现，下半年重大投资项目呈现传统基建提质升级、新型基建加速布局、产业项目占比提升、民生短板持续补齐的鲜明特征。其中，“六张网”建设成为核心抓手，多地明确将其纳入下半年重点攻坚任务。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Boosting investment, stabilizing industry, expanding foreign trade: local economies highlight key priorities for the second half.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, localities have been intensively deploying H2 economic work, focusing on advancing the planning and construction of the 'six networks', achieving stable industrial growth, and firmly stabilizing the foreign trade fundamentals, with related measures to be rolled out successively. A review finds that H2 major investment projects show distinct features of traditional infrastructure upgrading, accelerated new infrastructure deployment, a higher share of industrial projects, and continued reinforcement of livelihood weaknesses. Among them, the 'six networks' construction has become the core lever, with multiple localities explicitly incorporating it into key H2 tasks. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 杠杆ETF风暴一个月，韩国股市距离风险出清还有“最后一公里”
headlines.summary: 6月19日指数见顶后，KOSPI指数经历了一轮近40%的深度回撤。这场由个股杠杆产品引发的波动风暴，迫使韩国监管层在一个月内先后出台多轮措施。机构分析认为，短期来看，急跌中最危险的杠杆结构或已基本出清，短期降温效果初步达成，外资也开始阶段性回流。不过，散户单日爆仓率仍处于高位、波动率指数居高不下，尾部风险还未彻底出清，市场真正企稳尚需时日。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Leveraged ETF storm one month on: South Korean stock market still has 'the last mile' to risk clearance.
headlines.summary_en: After the index peaked on June 19, the KOSPI index underwent a near-40% deep pullback. This volatility storm triggered by individual stock leverage products forced South Korean regulators to roll out multiple rounds of measures within a month. Institutional analysis suggests that in the short term, the most dangerous leveraged structures in the sharp decline may have largely cleared out, with short-term cooling effects initially achieved and foreign capital beginning to return in stages. However, retail investors' single-day forced-liquidation rates remain high and the volatility index stays elevated, so tail risks have not been fully cleared and the market's true stabilization still needs time. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 地方中小银行纷纷推出大额存单，主打中短期产品
headlines.summary: 近期，国有大行及多家股份制银行重启5年期大额存单，地方中小银行也同步密集上新大额存单。对比来看，中小银行的大额存单利率具备明显优势，但产品最长仅设置3年期，整体仍以中短期产品为主。梳理中国货币网数据发现，7月份以来，新疆银行、保定银行、金台农商银行、嘉祥农商银行、徐州农商银行、玉树农商银行、泰顺温银村镇银行等超十家地方银行陆续发布大额存单发行公告，部分银行更是年内首次发行该类产品。7月份新公告发行大额存单的银行数量、产品数量，均显著高于6月份。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: Local small and mid-sized banks are rolling out large-denomination certificates of deposit, focusing on short-to-medium-term products
headlines.summary_en: Recently, major state-owned banks and several joint-stock banks have resumed issuing 5-year large-denomination certificates of deposit (CDs), while local small and medium-sized banks have also accelerated issuance of such CDs. Comparatively, CDs from small and medium-sized banks offer clear interest rate advantages, but the longest term available is only 3 years, with the overall focus remaining on short-to-medium-term products. Data from China Money Network shows that since July, over ten local banks, including Xinjiang Bank, Baoding Bank, Jintai Rural Commercial Bank, Jiaxiang Rural Commercial Bank, Xuzhou Rural Commercial Bank, Yushu Rural Commercial Bank, and Taishun Wenyin Village Bank, have successively issued announcements for CD issuance, with some banks issuing such products for the first time this year. The number of banks announcing new CD issuance and the number of products in July were both significantly higher than in June. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title: 图灵量子启动IPO辅导 资本化进程有望发挥示范效应
headlines.summary: 【图灵量子启动IPO辅导 资本化进程有望发挥示范效应】证监会官网显示，上海图灵智算量子科技股份有限公司已于2026年7月24日与国泰海通证券签署IPO辅导协议，并于8月5日在上海证监局完成备案。专业人士对记者表示，图灵量子启动IPO辅导，表明资本市场正加快将服务触角延伸至量子科技等未来产业。更为重要的是，图灵量子的资本化进程有望发挥示范效应，吸引产业资本、耐心资本和专业机构加大对量子科技产业的投入，推动创新链、产业链与资金链加快融合。

headlines.title_en: Turing Quantum initiates IPO tutoring; capitalization process may set a demonstration effect.
headlines.summary_en: [TuringQ launches IPO tutoring, capital markets process expected to have demonstration effect] The CSRC website shows Shanghai TuringQ Computing Quantum Technology Co., Ltd. signed an IPO tutoring agreement with Guotai Haitong Securities on July 24, 2026, and completed filing with the Shanghai CSRC bureau on August 5. Professionals told reporters that TuringQ's launch of IPO tutoring indicates capital markets are accelerating service extension into future industries like quantum technology. More importantly, TuringQ's capital markets process is expected to have a demonstration effect, attracting industrial capital, patient capital, and professional institutions to increase investment in the quantum technology industry, promoting faster integration of innovation, industrial, and capital chains.

headlines.title_en: Indium phosphide sector sees rising momentum; three concept stocks attract active institutional attention.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, indium phosphide prices have risen notably. Shanghai Nonferrous Metals Network data shows the August 6 average price of 4-inch InP substrates reached 6,250 yuan per wafer, up about 45% from the start of the year. The InP price rise also coincides with a surge in upstream raw material indium; Wind data shows refined indium quoted at 5,430 yuan/kg as of August 6, up over 80% from 2,980 yuan/kg at the start of the year. Driven by the AI wave, demand for InP substrates from optical modules has expanded sharply, pushing prices higher. InP is mainly used in high-speed optical module components for AIDC, and as optical module speeds evolve from 800G to 1.6T and 3.2T in recent years, InP substrates continue to improve and the supply-demand gap further widens. There are 18 A-share stocks positioned in the InP supply chain, 12 of which have published interim reports or earnings forecasts; based on H1 net profit and performance

headlines.title: 中国即将发行或正在发行的国债和政策性金融债
headlines.summary: 日前召开的中共中央政治局会议对货币政策作出新的部署，人民银行2026年下半年工作会议进一步细化落实要求，释放清晰政策信号。专家表示，在推动经济持续向新向优向好发展过程中，货币政策需要统筹平衡多重目标。当前，降准、降息仍在政策工具箱内，操作上将更加注重相机抉择，并把握好实施时点与力度；结构性工具将持续加码，聚焦科技创新、新质生产力、中小微企业等重点领域补短板。与此同时，财政金融协同促内需政策将持续优化，为经济持续回升向好营造适宜货币金融环境。

headlines.title: 可转债一级市场正在升温，今年以来累计发行51只同比增长104%
headlines.summary: 截至8月6日，今年以来累计发行51只可转债，规模合计607亿元，较上年同期分别增长104%和51%。与发行端回暖同时发生的，是存量可转债在加速退出。数据显示，年内已有123只可转债离场，市场存续规模较年初减少560亿元。业内人士认为，再融资政策优化打开了可转债发行通道，科技企业资本开支增加、机构配置需求旺盛，则为新券供需两端提供了支撑。可转债市场由此进入发行提速、结构调整的新阶段。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: The primary market for convertible bonds is heating up, with 51 issues so far this year, up 104% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: As of August 6, a total of 51 convertible bonds have been issued this year, with a combined scale of 60.7 billion yuan, up 104% and 51% year-on-year, respectively. Alongside the recovery in issuance, existing convertible bonds are accelerating their exit. Data shows that 123 convertible bonds have left the market this year, with the market's outstanding scale down 56 billion yuan from the beginning of the year. Industry insiders believe that optimized refinancing policies have opened the issuance channel for convertible bonds, while increased capital expenditure by tech companies and strong institutional allocation demand support both supply and demand for new issues. The convertible bond market has thus entered a new phase of accelerated issuance and structural adjustment. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 市场风格剧烈切换，基金换仓迎“大考”
headlines.summary: 7月以来，A股市场迎来剧烈风格切换，此前持续领涨的AI、半导体等科技成长板块出现大幅调整，而前期表现低迷的传统价值板块普遍迎来反弹。在此背景下，多只重仓AI、半导体方向的基金出现较大幅度的回撤。值得关注的是，这批遭遇重挫的基金中，部分产品在二季度刚刚完成大规模换仓，从消费、资源等传统板块切换至科技赛道。其中，既有基金经理交接导致风格变化的情形，也有基金经理在分化行情下主动选择了“追逐趋势”。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Market style shifts sharply; funds face a 'big test' in repositioning.
headlines.summary_en: Since July, the A-share market has seen sharp style rotation, with previously leading tech growth sectors like AI and semiconductors undergoing significant adjustments, while traditional value sectors that had lagged generally rebounded. In this context, multiple funds heavily weighted in AI and semiconductors have suffered sizable drawdowns. Notably, among these hard-hit funds, some products had just completed large-scale position shifts in Q2, moving from traditional sectors like consumer and resources into tech tracks. This includes both cases where fund manager handovers led to style changes and managers who actively chose to 'chase trends' amid differentiated markets. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 越疆奔赴创业板 讲了个新故事
headlines.summary: 【越疆奔赴创业板 讲了个新故事】8月5日，港股“协作机器人第一股”越疆科技（02432.HK）发布面向消费级市场的人形机器人“鹿萌”（DOBOTLUMO）。这款身高近1.3米、主打情绪感知与多地形行走能力的产品，被公司定义为“具身全栖”机器人。该产品试图同时覆盖家庭陪伴、运动陪练、科普教育及商业展演等多个场景。在创业板IPO即将上会的关键窗口，这一动作被视为越疆从工业协作机器人向家庭场景跨越的重要落子，亦是其向资本市场讲述的新故事。

headlines.title_en: Dobot heads to ChiNext with a new storyline.
headlines.summary_en: [Dobot heads to ChiNext with a new story] On August 5, Dobot (02432.HK), the 'first collaborative robot stock' on the Hong Kong exchange, released 'LUMO' (DOBOTLUMO), a humanoid robot targeting the consumer market. The product, nearly 1.3 meters tall and featuring emotion perception and multi-terrain walking capabilities, is defined by the company as an 'embodied all-terrain' robot, aiming to cover scenarios including home companionship, exercise coaching, science education, and commercial exhibitions. At a critical juncture ahead of its ChiNext IPO listing review, this move is seen as a key step in Dobot's transition from industrial collaborative robots to home scenarios, and a new story it is telling capital markets.

headlines.title: 机构研判中报窗口开启业绩驱动新周期
headlines.summary: 日前多方调研获悉，多家一线机构已形成明确共识：A股本轮调整本质是交易拥挤度的释放与估值阶段性收缩，AI产业长期成长逻辑并未发生实质性逆转，政策底信号显现之下，市场底仍需筹码、情绪与增量资金多重条件共振确认，而这一过程往往需事后回望方能定论。机构人士认为，随着中报业绩进入集中披露窗口，行情正逐步由预期驱动转向业绩兑现驱动，科技与涨价方向景气占优，但板块内部分化将加剧——具备真实业绩与技术壁垒的龙头有望在估值修复中率先受益，而单纯依赖概念与涨价弹性的标的将面临定价重估。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Institutions assess that the mid-year report window opens a new cycle driven by earnings.
headlines.summary_en: Recent multi-party research shows several leading institutions have formed a clear consensus: the essence of this A-share adjustment is a release of trading crowding and a phase of valuation contraction, with the long-term growth logic of the AI industry not substantively reversed; while policy-bottom signals have emerged, the market bottom still needs confirmation from the convergence of multiple conditions involving chips, sentiment, and incremental capital, a process that often can only be determined in hindsight. Institutional insiders believe that as interim earnings enter a concentrated disclosure window, the market is shifting from expectation-driven to earnings-delivery-driven, with tech and price-increase directions showing better fundamentals, but intra-sector divergence will intensify—leaders with real earnings and technological moats are expected to benefit first in valuation repairs, while targets relying purely on concepts and price-increase elasticity will face pricing reappraisal. (China Securities Journal)
